files.content:
scope: 'main'
name: '10.0.0.4'
restapi:
  listen: '0.0.0.0:8008'
  connect_address: '10.0.0.4:8008'
  authentication:
    username: patroni
    password: 'ag$ent'
etcd3:
  hosts: '10.0.0.1:2379,10.0.0.2:2379,10.0.0.3:2379,10.0.0.4:2379'
bootstrap:
  dcs:
    ttl: 30
    loop_wait: 10
    retry_timeout: 10
    maximum_lag_on_failover: 1048576
    failsafe_mode: true
    postgresql:
      use_pg_rewind: true
      use_slots: true
      parameters:
        compute_query_id: 'auto'
        hot_standby: 'on'
        max_replication_slots: '20'
        max_wal_senders: '20'
        password_encryption: 'scram-sha-256'
        pg_stat_statements.track: 'top'
        shared_preload_libraries: 'pg_stat_statements'
        wal_keep_size: '1GB'
        wal_level: 'replica'
        wal_log_hints: 'on'
  initdb:
    - encoding: UTF8
    - data-checksums
postgresql:
  listen: '*:25060'
  connect_address: '10.0.0.4:25060'
  data_dir: '/srv/postgres/data'
  bin_dir: '/usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin'
  pgpass: '/srv/postgres/conf/pgpass'
  use_unix_socket: true
  use_unix_socket_repl: false
  remove_data_directory_on_rewind_failure: true
  remove_data_directory_on_diverged_timelines: true
  authentication:
    superuser:
      username: postgres
      password: 'adm''in'
    replication:
      username: replicator
      password: 'rep"l'
    rewind:
      username: postgres
      password: 'adm''in'
  parameters:
    log_destination: 'stderr'
    logging_collector: 'off'
    ssl: 'on'
    ssl_cert_file: '/srv/postgres/tls/server.crt'
    ssl_key_file: '/srv/postgres/tls/server.key'
    ssl_min_protocol_version: 'TLSv1.2'
    unix_socket_directories: '/srv/postgres/run'
  pg_hba:
    - 'local all postgres peer'
    - 'local all all scram-sha-256'
    - 'host all all 127.0.0.1/32 scram-sha-256'
    - 'host all all ::1/128 scram-sha-256'
    - 'host replication replicator 127.0.0.1/32 scram-sha-256'
    - 'host replication replicator ::1/128 scram-sha-256'
    - 'hostssl replication replicator 0.0.0.0/0 scram-sha-256'
    - 'hostssl all all 0.0.0.0/0 scram-sha-256'
tags:
  nofailover: true
  noloadbalance: true
  nosync: true
  clonefrom: true

[databases]
postgres = host=127.0.0.1 port=25060 dbname=postgres pool_size=2
%include /srv/postgres/conf/pgbouncer-pools.ini

[pgbouncer]
listen_addr = *
listen_port = 25061
unix_socket_dir =
auth_type = scram-sha-256
auth_file = /srv/postgres/conf/pgbouncer-users.txt
auth_user = pgbouncer
auth_dbname = postgres
auth_query = SELECT username, password FROM pgbouncer.get_auth($1)
client_tls_sslmode = require
client_tls_cert_file = /srv/postgres/tls/server.crt
client_tls_key_file = /srv/postgres/tls/server.key
server_tls_sslmode = require
max_client_conn = 5000
default_pool_size = 16
ignore_startup_parameters = extra_float_digits,options
